title: Model Supply Sentinels: Triggered Recon for Regional Capacity Risk
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: produce a pragmatic playbook and automated signal pipeline that surfaces regional model-supply risk and suggests immediate operational actions (provision, fallback, procurement triggers). Why: customers experience transient spikes in latency or price when regional model pools reduce capacity; platform needs predictable automated responses to avoid customer impact and expensive manual procurement. Scope: define signal sources and scoring (availability, tail latency, spot price, quantization compatibility, freeze events from providers), design trigger thresholds (soft alerts vs hard triggers), enumerate fallback paths (model variants, region routing, pre-warmed reserved capacity), specify observability dashboards and runbooks, and prototype a signal->action circuit that can create tickets or trigger autoscale policies. Deliverables: 1) decision matrix with numeric thresholds and expected cost/latency tradeoffs, 2) signal definitions and weightings, 3) dashboard mockups and alert routing config, 4) prototype webhook for alert->autoscale or provisioning request, 5) procurement playbook for reserved capacity commitments. Success criteria: reduced manual procurement tickets, automated fallback executed for >=90% of simulated capacity events in staging, alert precision >65% (low false positive).
comments: 2026-02-19 - Kickoff: scoped with infra and eng-runbook teams. Engineering proposed sensor events from runtime (kernel OOM, queue depth, rollout failures). PM flagged procurement SLA needs.

2026-03-04 - PM decision: soft alerts first (notify on-call + create ticket), hard triggers after 3 correlated signals within 5 minutes (route traffic to fallback model variant and spin up reserved pool), pending security review for automated provisioning webhooks.

2026-03-10 - Ops feedback (Liam O'Connor): add a latency hysteresis window to avoid flip-flopping; proposed metric: 95th percentile sustained above threshold for 3 minutes.
Next steps: finalize threshold matrix, run 10 failure-mode simulations in staging, create alert->ticket runbook, schedule procurement sync with GTM for pricing commitments.
